segments.title: Hype Train Returns from Hell
segments.notes: Hype Train reappears after extended absence, describes hell's new middle management and permeable membrane; mentions wall insurance and hot dog string procurement.

segments.title: Zoran Mamdani Wins NYC Democratic Mayoral Primary
segments.notes: Case covers Mamdani's commanding primary victory over Cuomo, analyzes media reaction, plays concession and victory clips, discusses ranked-choice voting and cross-endorsement with Brad Lander.

segments.title: Trump Truth Social Rage & Schumer Hospitalization
segments.notes: Trump attacks Mamdani as '100% communist lunatic'; Schumer hospitalized for dehydration after gym fall; Case discusses squat numbers and glute discourse.

segments.title: Chet Brief Sign-Off
segments.notes: Chet appears momentarily to say goodbye, referencing his return to the permeable membrane.

segments.title: Amongst the Web with J. Drilla
segments.notes: Case hosts viral video review with guest J. Drilla (aspiring pop star); rates videos including Mystery PUA bootcamp ad, chastity belt content, and Amtrak social media.

segments.title: Trailer Time: Survival Island, Harvey Girls, Guns Up
segments.notes: Case and Trent watch movie trailers including a sexy island survival film, 1940s musical 'The Harvey Girls', and Kevin James action vehicle 'Guns Up'.

segments.title: Discord News: Joy Reid, Diddy Trial, Jesus Cloud, Quantum RSA, Armenian PM, Social Network 2
segments.notes: Liliana joins desk for Discord-sourced stories: Joy Reid anti-imperialism on CNN, Diddy trial sex therapist commentary, Jesus cloud apparition, Chinese 22-bit RSA break, Armenian PM penis challenge, Aaron Sorkin sequel plans.

segments.title: Munch & Crum: Sabrina Carpenter Album Cover Debate
segments.notes: Coach McGurk (Munch) oversees Crum's physical therapy; debate on whether new Sabrina Carpenter cover is 'too sexy or just right'; Crum barely verbal, communicates via grunts; Case declares Crum winner.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors full broadcast: covers Mamdani primary win, hosts Amongst the Web with J. Drilla, runs Trailer Time, co-anchors Discord news with Liliana, moderates Munch & Crum debate.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivers cold open sign-on as 'the dog that produces the show'; referenced re: wall insurance and hot dog string.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: hype correspondent. Returns from hell after extended absence; describes new infernal middle management and permeable membrane trauma; acknowledges subs and bits.

characters.notes: debate analyst. Appears as 'Coach McGurk' running Crum's court-ordered physical therapy; argues for maximum sexiness in media; claims Crum's body parts reattached with hot glue.

lore_notes.fact: Hell has new middle management making conditions 'extra shitty'; escape requires passing through permeable membrane described as 'Hell's Hymen' that has regrown stronger.
Wall hole originated from pen scratch one year ago; has expanded significantly; requires insurance before 'Join the Wall' entry.
Body parts came off during prison guard cleaning; reattached with hot glue; undergoing physical therapy with Coach McGurk (Munch in disguise).
Operating as 'Coach McGurk' — claims paid cleaning service/prison guards to hose down Crum; says mental recovery tied to physical.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell anchors a broadcast celebrating Zoran Mamdani's upset NYC Democratic mayoral primary win, analyzing the media meltdown and Trump's Truth Social rage. Hype Train returns from a hellish hiatus describing new infernal bureaucracy. Amongst the Web features aspiring pop star J. Drilla rating viral videos including a Mystery PUA bootcamp ad. Liliana joins for Discord news covering Joy Reid's anti-imperialism on CNN, Chinese quantum RSA breakthrough, and the Armenian PM's penis challenge. The show closes with Munch & Crum — Munch disguised as Coach McGurk — debating Sabrina Carpenter's album cover while Crum undergoes hot-glue physical therapy.
